item.title: Bringing ChatGPT for Teachers to more U.S. school districts
item.description: ChatGPT for Teachers is expanding to 55 U.S. school systems, bringing secure AI tools, training, and support to over 100,000 more educators and staff. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/bringing-chatgpt-for-teachers-to-more-us-school-districts

item.title: Learning never stops: How AI makes learning continuous
item.description: OpenAI’s new report explores how students and educators use ChatGPT to make learning more continuous, with support that extends beyond the classroom. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/learning-never-stops

item.title: How loveholidays is making everyone a builder with Codex
item.description: Discover how loveholidays uses OpenAI Codex to make software development accessible across the business, helping teams turn ideas into products faster. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/loveholidays

item.title: The Hugging Face incident and the road ahead
item.description: OpenAI shares findings from the Hugging Face security incident and the steps we’re taking to strengthen AI model security, monitoring, and alignment. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/hugging-face-incident-and-the-road-ahead

item.title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
item.description: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar explains how advances across chips, compute, models, and products compound to deliver more useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/the-full-stack-behind-abundant-intelligence

item.title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
item.description: Jalapeño is a custom inference chip from OpenAI that delivers faster, more power-efficient AI inference, with higher throughput and lower latency for modern models. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/jalapeno-first-results

item.title: Disrupting a new covert influence campaign from Russia
item.description: OpenAI banned Russia-origin accounts using AI to promote a fake Israel-based think tank and a “sovereignty” index praising Russia and criticizing the West. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/disrupting-malicious-uses-of-ai-influence-campaign-russia

item.title: Introducing the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex
item.description: Use the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex to analyze workspace usage, manage members and permissions, adjust limits, and act on admin requests. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/introducing-admin-plugin

item.title: Advancing price-performance for developers with GPT‑5.6 in Kiro
item.description: GPT‑5.6 is now available in Kiro, helping developers plan, build, review, and test software with better price-performance. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/gpt-5-6-in-kiro

item.title: Introducing AI Futures
item.description: Introducing AI Futures, a new OpenAI blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/introducing-ai-futures

item.title: Stampli cuts launch hours by 68% using ChatGPT Work
item.description: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/stampli
